# Northlight Advisory Services

> Fractional COO and AI adoption advisory for Canadian small businesses. Halifax-based. Strategy, tools, and engagements built for where you actually are.

Northlight Advisory Services is a Halifax, Nova Scotia–based strategy, operations advisory, and AI adoption practice founded by Elizabeth Lemoine. We work with Canadian founders and operators — typically organisations under 50 people — who need clear thinking they can act on, not a framework or a roadmap.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://bynorthlight.ca/): Overview of Northlight Advisory Services — who we work with, what we do, and how to get in touch.
- [Services](https://bynorthlight.ca/services.html): Advisory engagements (including the $99 Clarity Call), Northlight Meetings, and the Northlight Skills Market. Support hours and cancellation policy.
- [About](https://bynorthlight.ca/about.html): Elizabeth Lemoine — founder, 10+ years director-level operations experience, 300+ initiatives across 115+ countries.
- [Who We Help](https://bynorthlight.ca/who-we-help.html): Three locked client personas — the types of founders and operators Northlight works with.
- [Blog](https://bynorthlight.ca/blog/): Strategy, operations, and AI adoption articles written for Canadian small business owners.
- [FAQ](https://bynorthlight.ca/faq.html): Common questions about working with Northlight Advisory Services.
- [Case Studies](https://bynorthlight.ca/case-studies/): Project work including Northlight Vault, Northlight OS, Northlight Meetings, and the Skills Market.
- [Northlight Vault](https://bynorthlight.ca/vault.html): Free Windows desktop app — browse Google Drive, OneDrive, and Dropbox in a single interface.
- [Northlight Meetings](https://bynorthlight.ca/meetings.html): AI-powered meeting recorder and summariser for Windows. Records system audio and microphone, transcribes in real time with Groq.
- [Resources](https://bynorthlight.ca/resources.html): Free tools and templates for Canadian small business owners.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bynorthlight.ca/northlight-privacy.html): How Northlight Advisory Services handles personal information under PIPEDA.
- [Sitemap](https://bynorthlight.ca/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap.

## Who We Work With

Canadian founders and operators navigating a moment of transition — scaling, restructuring, adopting AI, or navigating a regulatory or market shift. Typically organisations under 50 people. Halifax and Atlantic Canada focus, but we work with Canadian businesses nationally.
